services.description: Search and report on customer orders, track order status, view sales totals and delivery updates

slots.name: tracking_code
slots.description: The tracking code of an order, e.g. TM-ABCDEF

slots.name: status
slots.description: Order status: Order Placed, Confirmed, Packed, Shipped, Delivered

slots.name: customer_name
slots.description: Name of the customer who placed the order

slots.name: customer_phone
slots.description: Phone number of the customer who placed the order

slots.name: date_range
slots.description: Time period, e.g. today, yesterday, last 7 days, this week, last month

slots.name: product_name
slots.description: Name of a product in an order

intents.name: GetOrderCount
intents.description: Count how many orders were placed in a given time period

intents.name: GetOrderByCode
intents.description: Look up a single order using its tracking code

intents.name: GetOrdersByStatus
intents.description: List orders that currently have a given status

intents.name: GetOrdersByCustomer
intents.description: Find all orders placed by a given customer name or phone number

intents.name: GetSalesTotal
intents.description: Sum of order totals for a given time period

intents.name: UpdateOrderStatus
intents.description: Change the status of an order to a new value

services.description: Search products, check stock and view the product catalogue

slots.name: category
slots.description: Product category: school, side, travel, chappal, crocs, combo, tcombo, pant, shirt, tshirt, airpod, headphone, shoe, analog, smart, smc

slots.name: product_code
slots.description: Unique code of a product, e.g. SC1LIK

slots.name: out_of_stock
slots.description: Whether the product is out of stock

intents.name: GetProductCount
intents.description: Count total products, optionally within one category

intents.name: GetProductsByCategory
intents.description: List products in a given category

intents.name: GetProductByCode
intents.description: Look up one product by its product code

intents.name: GetOutOfStock
intents.description: List products that are currently out of stock
